aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.heat.colors: Dull red 400–600°, cherry 600–800°, orange 800–1000°, yellow 1000–1200°, white above. Each metal works in its own window; above it, a part on the coals scales and loses a star every few seconds.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.heat.fuel: Coal and charcoal burn to 1250° (875° without bellows). Blaze rods reach 1450°, lava 1650° and lights itself. Wood and other furnace fuels only reach 700°. Iron melts at 1150°, steel alloys at 1350°+, netherite at 1550°.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.heat.fuel.title: Fuel
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.heat.quality: Each part has 1–5 stars from how well it was made. A tool's quality is their average: ★ ×0.85, ★★★ ×1.0, ★★★★★ ×1.15 on durability, speed and damage. All five-star parts make a Masterwork: +1 upgrade slot and a golden name.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.heat.quench: Water: +10% durability (tier-3+ parts dunked above their window crack). Fish oil: +5% attack speed. Brine: +5% mining speed. Frost brine: Frost-tempered steel. Steel's Tempered trait doubles all of it.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.material.handle: Handle: ×%s durability · ×%s speed · ×%s damage · ×%s attack speed
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.material.head: Head: %s durability · speed %s · mines %s · +%s damage

Pour molten emberforged steel over a bone head on the Casting Bench.
Carve bones or bone blocks.

Melt copper.
Carve deer hide; or wrap a grip.
Trim feathers or down feathers into fletching.
Alloy netherite with echo shards (Great Crucible).
Alloy steel with blaze powder.
Chisel flint.
Melt gold.
Melt iron.
Carve leather; or wrap a handle.
Melt netherite (Great Crucible).
Melt obsidian (a blaze or lava fire).
Alloy steel with a black pearl.
Alloy steel with a permafrost shard.
Alloy copper and gold, half and half.
Twist silk or string into bowstrings; or wrap a handle.
Alloy netherite with a nether star (Great Crucible).
Fold hot iron with charcoal on the anvil, or alloy iron and charcoal in a crucible.
Chisel cobblestone (or any stone tool material).

aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.modifier.per: Per level: %s %s (a few at a time)
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.1: No metal yet? Craft a Carving Bench and a Carving Knife. Lay cobblestone (with a chisel), flint, bone or wood on the bench, choose a part and cut in rhythm. Stone hammer faces carve too, so your first Smithing Hammer is two stone faces and a wooden handle.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.1.title: 1. The stone age
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.2: On the Assembly Bench, lay the parts in order (head, binding, handle) and rivet with the hammer. Stars on each part add up to the tool's quality.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.2.title: 2. Putting a tool together
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.3: Build a Forge Hearth, feed it coal and light it with flint and steel. Put Bellows next to it, nozzle in, and pump for full heat. A fan blowing into it does the pumping for you.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.3.title: 3. Fire
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.4: A Crucible on the hearth melts ingots, ore and old metal gear. Make a sand mold on the Casting Bench, ladle the metal in, let it cool and knock out a rough part.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.4.title: 4. Melting and casting
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.5: Heat the rough part in the forge until it glows, lay it on the Smithing Anvil and strike in the sweet spot. Each move of the plan needs a good strike. Your timing makes the stars. Ingots can be forged from scratch too.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.5.title: 5. The anvil
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.6: Dunk the hot part in the Quench Trough to set it: water, fish oil, brine or frost brine each give something. Unquenched metal stays soft.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.6.title: 6. Quenching
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.7: Etch modifiers into a tool's slots at the Runesmith Table with catalysts and a chisel. Masterworks (all 5-star parts), books, music discs and boss trophies give extra slots. The Whetstone Wheel keeps blades sharp and grinds modifiers off.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.start.7.title: 7. Modifiers
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.anvil: Lay a hot piece on it and strike with the smithing hammer when the marker is in the sweet spot (gold is perfect). Sneak to strike heavy: two moves, a narrower spot. Ingots are forged from scratch (sneak-click with an empty hand to choose the part); hot iron with charcoal folds into steel.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.assembl: Lay parts in order (head, binding, handle); a part no tool takes next won't go down. Rivet with the hammer. A finished tool on the bench takes a new part (modifiers stay) or its head material and three hammer taps to repair.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.bellows: Point its nozzle at a hearth and pump it (click, or blow a fan into it): full heat for two seconds, fuel burns faster.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.carving: Lay wood, stone, flint, bone, bamboo, hide, string or feathers down, sneak-click to choose the part, and cut in rhythm with the knife (the chisel for stone and flint): cuts on the beat make better stars. Lay a handle down and click with leather or hide to wrap it.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.casting: Molds: put a molding box down, pack it with 4 sand, press any part (or an ingot or nugget) into it. Or lay 4 clay balls, press a part, and fire the clay mold in the forge (it lasts 32 pours). Pour, let it cool, knock the casting out with a hammer: a rough part. Pour metal over a finished part to clad it.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.crucibl: Sits on a lit hearth (or lava, magma, a campfire). Holds 4 ingots. Drop metal in, wait for it to melt, add an alloy's additives and stir three times with the stirring rod. Take metal out with a ladle or a spout. Fish melt into fish oil at a low heat.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.fire_br: Fire clay baked into bricks: the Great Crucible is built from them.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.forge: The heart of the shop. Feed it coal, charcoal, blaze rods or lava, light it with flint and steel, and lay up to three pieces on the coals. On its own a fire reaches 70% of its fuel's heat; bellows beside it (or a fan blowing into it) take it all the way. The dial on the front shows the heat; the crucible goes on top.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.great_d: The Great Crucible: a hollow column two blocks deep on a 3x3 floor of fire bricks, walled by fire bricks on both layers, with this drain in the wall (tap outward). Lava (or a lit hearth) under the floor's center heats it. Holds 36 ingots, melts tier-4 metal and makes the great alloys. Drop pieces into the hollow.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.rune_ta: The tool in the middle, up to four catalyst stacks around it. Strike four times with the chisel to etch the modifier the catalysts make into a free slot. Incremental modifiers take what's there and remember the rest.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.spout: Fit it beside a crucible (or the Great Crucible's drain) over a casting bench. Click it or give it a redstone pulse and it pours until the mold is full.
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.trough: Fill it with water, fish oil, brine (water and dried kelp) or frost brine (water and a permafrost shard) and dunk a hot part to set it. Water: +10% durability but tier-3 parts dunked too hot can crack. Fish oil: +5% attack speed. Brine: +5% mining speed. Frost brine: Frost-tempered steel. Unquenched metal stays soft (-10% durability).
aftrhrs.smithing.almanac.station.wheel: Hold a bladed tool against it (keep right-click held) to restore its Edge. Sneak-click to grind the newest modifier off; a Scribe's Crystal in your off hand keeps it as a modifier crystal.

aftrhrs.smithing.modifier.treasure_sense: Better chance of treasure (works as Luck of the Sea).

aftrhrs.smithing.modifier.veinseeker.des: Mines up to 12 more blocks of the same ore vein.
aftrhrs.smithing.modifier.venomous.desc: Hits poison (I, then II) for 4 s.

aftrhrs.smithing.tool.broad_axe.desc: Broad axe head, tough binding, tough handle. Fells whole trees.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.crossbow.desc: Bow limb, stock grip, bowstring. Holds a shot.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.dagger.desc: Blade, guard, grip (makes 2). Fast; strike from the off hand; +50% from behind.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.excavator.desc: Large plate, tough binding, tough handle. Digs 3x3.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.fishing_rod.desc: Rod limb, line and hook. Pulls harder in fish fights.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.greatsword.desc: Broad blade, guard, pommel, tough handle. Slow, wide and heavy.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.hatchet.desc: Axe head, binding, handle. Chops, strips logs, disables shields.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.hoe.desc: Hoe blade, binding, handle. Tills; right-click a ripe crop to harvest and replant.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.longbow.desc: Two bow limbs, grip, bowstring. Powerful but slow.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.mace.desc: Hammer face, pommel, handle. The farther you fall, the harder it hits.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.mattock.desc: Pick head and axe head on one handle: mines stone and wood.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.pickaxe.desc: Pick head, binding, handle. The miner's tool.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.scythe.desc: Broad blade, tough binding, tough handle. Harvests and replants 3x3.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.shield.desc: Large plate and a handle rim. Metal shields recover from axes faster.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.shortbow.desc: Bow limb, grip, bowstring. Quick to draw.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.shovel.desc: Shovel blade, binding, handle. Digs and makes paths.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.sledge.desc: Hammer face and two plates on a tough handle. Mines 3x3.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.smithing_hammer.de: Two hammer faces on a handle: the anvil's tool. Its head material makes the strike meter more forgiving.
aftrhrs.smithing.tool.spear.desc: Spearhead on a tough handle. +1 reach; +30% when sprinting.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.bedrock_born.desc: Mines faster as it wears: up to +30% speed near the end of its durability.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.deepdelver.desc: +25% mining speed below Y 0; 15% slower above Y 64.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.ember.desc: Smelts a quarter of what it mines; hits set the target on fire for 3 s.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.fireproof.desc: Immune to fire and lava; +20% damage in the Nether.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.frost_tempered.de: Quenched in frost brine: +10% durability and +20% speed in cold biomes.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.frostbite.desc: Hits slow the target (Slowness I, 2 s); +20% mining speed in cold biomes.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.gilded.desc: +1 Fortune on tools, +1 Looting on weapons.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.hush.desc: Your mining and steps make no sculk vibrations; +3 damage on your first hit at a target.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.kindled.desc: Hits within 2 s of each other stack +0.5 damage (up to +3).
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.lodestone.desc: Drops within 3 blocks of what you break fly to you.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.lustrous.desc: +1 upgrade slot for each rose gold part (up to 2).
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.radiant.desc: Mends 1 durability every 10 s in sunlight; +1 ability slot.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.resonant.desc: Mining stone rings out the ores within 6 blocks (they sparkle for a moment).
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.seasoned.desc: A wooden handle grows tougher with use: +1 durability per 50 blocks mined, up to +100.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.serrated.desc: Bites deeper as it wears: up to +2 damage near the end of its durability.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.splintering.desc: Critical hits make the target bleed: 1 heart over 3 seconds.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.springy.desc: +10% attack speed, and +10% draw speed on bows.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.steady.desc: Bow sway reduced by 40%: arrows fly truer.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.sure_grip.desc: Never slips, wet or dry: +5% attack speed.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.tidebound.desc: No mining penalty underwater; +2 damage while it rains or you are wet.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.tidelucky.desc: +1 Luck while held: better catches and finds.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.unyielding.desc: Never loses more than 1 durability at a time, but works 20% slower.
aftrhrs.smithing.trait.warping.desc: What you break goes straight into your pack.
item.aftrhrs.molding_box.desc: Put it on a Casting Bench and pack it with 4 sand to make a sand mold.
item.aftrhrs.smith_chisel.desc: Cuts stone and flint; etches runes at the Runesmith Table.
item.aftrhrs.smith_knife.desc: Cuts wood, bone, hide, string and feathers on the Carving Bench.
item.aftrhrs.smith_ladle.desc: Carries up to 4 ingots of molten metal from a crucible to a mold; tipped into water it sets into ingots.
item.aftrhrs.smith_tongs.desc: Pick hot pieces up without a burn; stations take pieces from them and put pieces into them.
item.aftrhrs.stirring_rod.desc: Three stirs turn the right mix in a hot crucible into its alloy.
